## df17e660cb8e

**No issue found.** I checked the four canonical pairs, 600 generated scenes, six declared competitors, an extra “ignore checkpoint 6” rival, the task-local suite, and Racket rule smoke. Canonical self-check/mirror failures were 0/4 and generated self-check failures were 0/600. Identity, direct-start/end, reverse-order, paint-all-open, and wrong-route-color rivals differed on 600/600 scenes; row-major ordering differed on 370/600. The undeclared ignore-6 rival differed on all 254 sampled three-intermediate scenes. All four orientations appeared exactly 50 times per band. Task tests passed 12/12 and Racket smoke passed. Evidence: `checks/audit-probe.json`, `checks/audit-df17-task-tests/`, and `checks/audit-df17-rule-smoke/`.

Easy generation had only 127 unique grids among 200 draws because its bounded ladder templates are intentionally anchor-heavy. This is a diversity limitation, not a reproduced semantic defect; medium/hard and orientation/checkpoint schedules still exercised the checked rivals.
